about: The source model of an HDF5 file (spec/zarrify/hdf5.md §8 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/hdf5.md#8-hdf5-profile>): the elements a parser emits, which are the IMS profile's (spec/zarrify/ims.md §5.2 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/ims.md#52-elements>), and the budgets of the walk and of the data the profile reads. The rules of the HDF5 subset are the binary layer, checked by the HDF5 reader (`hdf5/mod.rs`) where the profile reads each structure; projections read a valid IR and check nothing.

elements.about: The IR of an HDF5 file, as the IMS profile's (spec/zarrify/ims.md §5.2 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/ims.md#52-elements>): objects numbered in canonical order (depth first from the root group, a group's hard links in ascending byte order of their names), then the objects no path reaches in ascending address order; the global heap collections that attributes and datasets of strings name. Bytes no element claims are gaps.

superblock.type: {signature,version,...} (48 bytes for versions 2 and 3, 96 or 100 for 0 and 1)

superblock_extension.about: the superblock extension's object header, as an object's

objects/<i>.about: object i (a group, dataset or named datatype): its header and the structures it names

children.checksum: <u4 after a version 2 header's first block
children.messages/<k>: struct: header, data (an attribute message a struct of prelude, name, datatype, dataspace, value; a link message a struct of fields, name, target)
children.blocks/<j>: a version 2 continuation block's signature and checksum
children.symbol_table: struct: heap (header, data), nodes/<k> (header, entries), snods/<k> (header, entries)
children.chunks/<n>: data: the chunk at row-major grid index n; form geometry {chunk, size}, codec {filters, mask}, recipe the whole chunk
children.data: data: a contiguous dataset's data; form geometry {shape, size}, codec {filters}, recipe the whole range

global_heaps/<k>.about:
a global heap collection: header, objects/

(header, data), free (header)

constraints.message: budget: objects more than {walk_depth} links deep

storage.about: the bytes of a dataset of strings or references, which the profile reads

constraints.message: budget: a dataset of strings or references of more than {max_storage_bytes} bytes

strings.about: the strings of the datasets presented
